title: docs(pm-dispatch): a security finding on a private repository is an ordinary `security` issue; the relay withholds a refusal message that quotes the body
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xCF4DobLCow88r565SX1vj9)_

Fixes #30114

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

`dispatch-gates --tier` reads a MANDATORY model tier for `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` (clause ① of the model-tiering ruling). It is waived by the maintainer's standing order of 2026-11-03, and this card ran on the project's default model. The dispatching seat runs the contract review.

Serial: #30271 waits on this card

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:私有仓(今天是 cloud)的安全发现改为该仓带 `security` 标签的普通 issue,经中继立卡、机制写在卡里、照卡派修;公开仓仍是草稿安全公告。中继执行器在请求被拒时,不再把引用了请求正文的平台 `message` 印进公开运行日志。
- 为什么改:你的原话「cloud 私有仓库可以直接用带 security 标签的普通 issue，立卡修改 skills」,以及裁定「A2 本卡里一起修中继」;行数上限按你 07:54Z 的裁定(选项 A)64 → 65。
- 风险与回滚:只改内部 agent 规程与 `scripts/pm` 中继脚本,不发包(`skip-changeset`);回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`security-findings.md` 第 3 节(L19–L30)与第 6 节 L45;`execute.mjs` 的 `requestLanded` 失败路径。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs --self-test`,预期 284 例全过;`node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`,预期退出 0、`security-findings.md` 65 行(上限 65)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

### The rule (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/security-findings.md`)

- §3: a seat tells a public repository from a private one by the affected repository's `private` flag, read from the API when the private card is filed, never recalled (L19).
- §3: on a private repository, the private card is an ordinary issue with the `security` label, filed through the relay's `issue_create`, and it holds the mechanism (L29). Its fix is dispatched from that issue like any card at `xhigh`, with no card-less order and no advisory (L30).
- §2's "no issue" and §3's advisory lines, including fallback A, apply to public repositories (L13, L20, L27; fallback A at L25 names only the advisory operations, so it is public-only by its own terms).
- §6, item 2 of the card: on a private repository too, PR titles, PR bodies, commits and changesets state only the rule and link the issue, because a private repository can be made public and its history goes with it (L45).
- §9's "two things" line: a seat files the private card per §3 and rings the doorbell with `#N` on a private repository (L63). A QA runner's finding reaches its PM session first (`checklist-test` L266), so the line names seats only.
- §4's public line names the owner seat (L34), as §9's blocked-task line (L65) does, because a relay refusal now goes to `security#1` first (L64).
- §8 (one place) is kept.

### Pointers whose wording would now be wrong

- `filing-gate.md` L15: "not a card" becomes "does not pass this gate".
- `lanes/security.md` L10 and L16: the private card per §3, and the doorbell carries `#N` on a private repository. L48: the patrol treats an open `security` card as mis-disclosed on a public repository only; on a private repository it is the private card.
- `SKILL.md` L165 (lane table): drops "card-less order" from the fix route.
- `checklist-test/SKILL.md` L266 (claim widened by the seat): "a security finding is not a card" becomes the runner's own duty, "the runner files no card for a security finding". The PM files the private card.
- `project-forms.md` L48 (claim widened by the seat, comment 6704480966): the `Notify: security` doorbell rings when a private card is built (「私卡建成」, either branch of §3), not only a draft advisory.

`.claude/agents/os-dev.md` L49, `lanes/server.md` L52, `lanes/review.md` L21, `project-forms.md` L52 and `rest-channel.md` L50–51 point at the file without wording that is now wrong. Left unchanged.

### The relay (`scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs`)

`requestLanded`'s generic failure path used to print `HTTP {status} — {json.message}` as the platform gave it. A refusal whose message quoted the request body (an `issue_create` title or body, say) reached the row, the `✗ action` log line and both step-summary lines of a public run. Now the status is always kept, and the message is printed only when it reproduces no prose of the body sent. The test is the one the advisory rows use (`advisoryRefusalCause`): `advisoryProseOf` of the body and a 16-character `quotesKnown` window, raw and flattened. A quoting message is replaced by "the platform's message is not printed: it quotes the body sent, and no row prints that". Nothing else changes: the GraphQL branch and the 2xx legs are untouched.

## Tests

The executor self-test battery for an `issue_create` on a private repository (added by seat 1's work, 5 cases) gains 3 cases, now 8. The battery floor goes 23 → 24, because `main` added the mailbox branch delete battery meanwhile. All fixtures use synthetic text.

- A 422 whose message quotes the body: FAILED, status 422 kept, the marker in no log line, row, step summary or annotation.
- A title whose every 16-character run holds a pipe, quoted back with slashes: caught on the flattened side.
- A 410 whose message quotes nothing: printed as given.

Mutation proof (each run on the final code with one change, then restored):

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| none | `284 cases pass across 24 batteries`, exit 0 |
| fix reverted (the old one-line `return`) | 2 of 284 fail (the quoting refusal, the flattened run), exit 1 |
| flattened comparison dropped | 1 of 284 fails (the flattened run), exit 1 |

## Acceptance notes

### Ruling of record for the ceiling

Comment 6704167516 on #30114 (seat 3, 2026-11-07T07:55Z): "Maintainer `huangyiirene` ruled at 2026-11-07T07:54Z (option A of the seat's question in the project thread): raise the line ceiling of `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/security-findings.md` from 64 to 65 for the one-line remainder the card thread measured after three real same-file deletions. Not option B (folding L31 and L47 into one line)." (Those were the line numbers before the deletions; on the head they are L30 and L45.)

Seat 1's earlier raise to 67, which cited the card body, is reverted. The 65 row stands on this ruling alone.

### Line budget (`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, exit 0)

| File | Lines (main → head) | Ceiling | Bytes (main → head) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `references/security-findings.md` | 64 → 65 | 64 → 65 (ruling above) | 3,601 → 3,800 |
| `references/lanes/security.md` | 53 → 53 | unchanged | 3,156 → 3,190 |
| `references/filing-gate.md` | 67 → 67 | unchanged | 6,558 → 6,561 |
| `pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` | 319 → 319 | unchanged | 32,177 → 32,159 |
| `checklist-test/SKILL.md` | 276 → 276 | unchanged | 19,278 → 19,288 |
| `references/project-forms.md` | 59 → 59 | unchanged | 4,531 → 4,525 |

Every touched prose line is ≤ 120 B (largest: `security-findings.md` L20 117, `lanes/security.md` L48 119; `security-findings.md` L63 is now 105, L34 84; `project-forms.md` L48 110 → 104). The `SKILL.md` L165 table row goes 333 → 315 B, under its pin. Bytes measured without the newline.

`security-findings.md`: +4 lines added (L19, L29, L30, L45), three deleted, net +1:

| Deleted line | Surviving home |
|---|---|
| §3 "a private repository has no private vulnerability reporting, so those operations stay a hand-off" | stale: the private-repository branch (L19, L29, L30) replaces it |
| §3 "a seat never reports privately or writes an advisory under its own account: GitHub writes go only through the relay, as the App" | `pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` seat invariants L94–95 (content writes only through the REST relay, the write side always `objectstack-fleet[bot]`), plus the same file's L22 (a seat-account read is refused) and L25 (no re-send under another account) |
| §4 the cross-repo finder's filing line, "file through the relay in the framework repository (§3); relay refused ⇒ hand the mechanism to the maintainer in session" | §3 L19–L20 (the affected repository's flag decides; the advisory sits on the affected repository) and §9 L63 (every seat files the private card per §3), L64 (relay refused ⇒ to `security#1`, the maintainer when vacant). This line had also named the maintainer where §9 names the seat. |

L20 gets "on the affected repository" back, so the repository the card goes on stays named after the §4 line goes.

## Review fixes (contract review 6704473385)

- **M1** `security-findings.md` L63: drops 「与 QA runner」, so only a seat files the private card. That matches `checklist-test` L266 and the mailbox recogniser (a QA runner's finding reaches its PM session privately first). 119 → 105 B, no line cost.
- **S1** `project-forms.md` L48 (claim widened, 6704480966): 「草稿公告建成」 becomes 「私卡建成」, so the doorbell also rings for a private repository's `security` issue. 110 → 104 B, net 0 lines.
- **N1** `security-findings.md` L34: 「with the maintainer」 becomes 「with the owner seat」, as L65 says. The rule means the seat: L64 routes a relay refusal to `security#1` first and to the maintainer only when the seat is vacant. Same bytes (84), no line cost.
- **S2** is filed as #31103 (a repository-qualified number for the `Notify: security · #N` doorbell in `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs`); it is outside this claim.
- **N2** (fallback A L25 stays public-only by its own terms) and **N3** (a non-quoting refusal message is printed unflattened, as before) are left as they are.

## Verification

Each ran with its exit code captured before any pipe, after building `@objectstack/formula`, `@objectstack/lint` and `@objectstack/objectql`. All 47 exited 0.

</details>

- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch claude/project-thread-kk5w88`: GOVERNED, Tier S (席内达档复核落地): `.claude/**` ×6. `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` and `scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs` are not on the register. 94 changed lines (+73 / −21), under 3000.
- `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD`: exit 0 before every push.
